name: kattakath-workspace
description: One install for Google Workspace in Claude: declares the official Google connectors for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides (empty-URL entries, the shape Anthropic's own plugins use, so the account's existing claude.ai connectors are reused and nothing new signs in), plus a routing skill for which app and tool to reach for, and the confirm-before-write rules.
